title: customer-signal-kaleidoscope-sprint-notes-apr-2028
summary: Sprint-style synthesis of recent customer feedback (Mar-Apr 2028). Emphasis on low-effort mitigations, experimental guardrails, and clustered feature asks across edtech/fintech/healthcare customers.
body:
Purpose:
This note collects the raw threads from recent CS calls, tradeshow followups, and in-product feedback (Mar 20 — Apr 8), clusters them into high-level themes, and proposes pragmatic next steps: quick mitigations, small experiments, and owners. Tone = field notes + quick triage; not a final roadmap.

Methodology / provenance:
- Sources: 11 customer calls, 3 post-demo surveys, 2 bug reports, and 8 Slack threads (public CS channel + private threads).
- Prioritization: rough impact x effort + customer urgency flags. Scoring is intentionally fuzzy (fast triage for PMs/Eng to iterate).

Top emergent themes (high-level):
1) Predictable latency at 99.99th pctail — customers want better tail visibility and actionable mitigations.
2) Model pinning + per-customer variant control — enterprises ask for easier API-level pinning and per-tenant fallbacks.
3) Cost transparency per feature/route — dev teams need token-level and call-path cost breakdowns (not just aggregate).
4) Session debugging + traceability — SREs and platform teams want deterministic traces for sessions and cached prefix reuse.
5) Embedding cache invalidation & visibility — data teams need a clear UX around cache TTLs, invalidation triggers, and stale-score signals.
6) Function/tool-calling reliability — systematic failure modes when tool schemas evolve mid-rollout.

Representative micro-vignettes (anonymized):
- Fintech customer: “We hit a spike where 1 in 5 requests spiked to 600ms. We need a way to auto-fallback to a cheaper/shorter-context model for tail reduction and keep per-request audit of fallback.”
- Edtech startup: “Embedding updates are frequent; our retraining cycle invalidates caches and we have no visibility into warm vs cold embedding hits — hurt latency and costs.”
- Healthcare integrator: “We want VPC-deployed Private control plane to allow per-model pinning via their infra CI (not console-only). Also stricter audit hooks on model swaps.”

Clustered feature asks (grouped by theme) with quick triage notes:
A. Tail latency + fallback policies
  - Ask: per-route tail SLOs and auto-fallback policy (route->variant mapping).
  - Customer signal: requested by 7 accounts (mix of SaaS and enterprise).
  - Quick mitigation: expose 95/99/99.9 latency breakdown in Console and add an alert template. (Effort: small UI + metrics)
  - Medium experiment: server-side A/B that routes >Xms to fallback model variant and records quality delta. (Effort: med, risk: needs eval harness)

B. Model pinning + rollout controls
  - Ask: API to pin model versions per-customer or per-route + ability to specify allowed fallback families.
  - Customer signal: 5 enterprise customers + 2 platform teams.
  - Quick mitigation: doc + example scripts for current workarounds (policy rules in rollout config). (Effort: tiny)
  - Medium: add pinning API endpoint + console quick toggle (Effort: med-high)

C. Cost transparency (per-call path)
  - Ask: token-by-token cost traces, per-route attribution, cost anomalies.
  - Quick mitigation: exportable CSV showing per-request token counts and model used (Effort: small)
  - Longer: per-route cost graphs with anomaly detection and suggested batching settings. (Effort: med)

D. Embedding cache visibility & invalidation
  - Ask: show TTL, hit/miss histograms, and provide programmatic invalidation endpoint plus console action.
  - Quick mitigation: add “cache hit rate” column to existing embedding index table (Effort: small)
  - Experiment: automated cache invalidation heuristics based on semantic drift (Effort: high + research)

E. Session debugging and KV cache traceability
  - Ask: capture session-level KV cache traces and allow replay.
  - Quick mitigation: allow per-session debug logs to be toggled with redaction defaults. (Effort: small)
  - Security note: any debug/logging must scrub customer PII by default; tie into compliance.

F. Function calling resilience
  - Ask: schema evolution safety, contract enforcement, and graceful degradation to non-tooling generation.
  - Quick mitigation: warn in Console when function schema differs from recent calls + provide migration diff. (Effort: small)
  - Longer: tight integration with SDKs for runtime contract validation and automatic stubbing. (Effort: med-high)

Prioritization snapshot (field-triage):
- Quick wins (0–2 wks): expose latency pctiles in console, CSV export per-request token/model, add cache hit-rate column, publish pinning workarounds doc, Console warning for function schema drift.
- Medium (1–3 months): pinning API & console toggle, per-route cost graphs + anomaly detection, per-session debug toggle with redaction, fallback routing A/B.
- Research (quarter+): automated semantic cache invalidation, auto-quantization suggestions tied to specific workload tests, session replay for KV cache.

Open questions / risks:
- Quality regression measurement: how to measure user-visible quality delta when we fallback to cheaper variants? Need small eval prompt sets per-customer (privacy concerns).
- Compliance impact: session traces must be opt-in for Private customers and default-redacted for Hosted. Coordinate with Security & Compliance.
- Cost of tracing: high-cardinality traces could spike costs; consider sampling strategy.

Proposed owners & next steps (this sprint):
- Asha K (CS): consolidate demo scripts + collect 3 canonical prompt sets (one per vertical) by 2028-04-22.
- Marcus L (Platform PM): spec for pinning API + example curl by 2028-04-26 (priority: medium).
- Emilia S (Console Eng): add latency pctiles and cache hit-rate column to Console MVP by 2028-04-30.
- Jordan P (Research/Applied ML): feasibility note on semantic cache invalidation by 2028-05-10.

Suggested quick communicators for customers (templated blurbs):
- Tail latency visibility: "We're surfaceing per-route latency percentiles this week and will share alert templates you can enable. Would you like us to enable a trial dashboard for your org?"
- Pinning workaround guide: short doc linking to policy config and example rollout rules.

Appendix: raw snippet excerpts (anonymized)
- "We had 2 incidents where model swap without audit caused a regression — would like a blocklist for auto-rollouts." — major-scale marketplace.
- "Embedding cache TTL is effectively unknown to us; we only notice cost when bills spike after retraining." — mid-market analytics customer.

Notes-to-self / TODOs:
- Add customer request IDs next pass (JIRA links).
- Share with Security for redaction checklist before enabling session debug for Hosted.
- Run a 2-week micro-experiment for fallback routing with one willing customer; draft success metrics.

End of note.

(Informal — feel free to clip sections into PRD, RFC, or customer follow-up emails.)
